Abstract Keywords
The acoustic environment of the classroom is one of the most important factors influencing the multimedia classroom;
teaching and learning effects of the teacher and students. It is critical to ensure good speech speech intelligibility;
intelligibility in classrooms. However, due to some factors, it may not be easy to achieve an ideal acoustic environment;
